notes: Breadboard ravine separates top bank (t, rows a-e) from bottom bank (b, rows f-j). The manual's 'row 1' is taken as column 1 of the catalogue's naming.
LED anode (long leg) in 1t.e on the left/top side of the ravine; cathode in 1b.f on the other side. Wire1's male end goes in 1t.a, which is the same strip as the anode.
Resistor leg 1 shares the cathode strip (1b.h is in column 1 bottom bank). Leg 2 goes in column 5 bottom bank (any free row on that side); wire2 male end shares that strip (5b.j).
Resistor value is not given in the manual; 330 ohm assumed as typical for 3.3 V.
Jumper-wire-mf: port 'a' is assumed to be the male end (breadboard) and 'b' the female end (Pi header pin).
The Pi's 3V3 pin is 3V3.1 and GND is GND.1; the manual does not specify which physical pins, so these were chosen.
